fixed.root_cause: GovernedWriteChatService returned approval_required without creating an ApprovalRequest.
fixed.fix: Policy ask now creates TaskContractDraft, TaskPreview and ApprovalRequest before any execution.

fixed.root_cause: Persistent chat send bypassed ChatPermissionGrantService before normal routing.
fixed.fix: Persistent send now handles temporary permission grants before operation routing.

fixed.root_cause: Canonical project_generation did not enter the governed rebuild handler and report-based resume reused a source-target rebuild service.
fixed.fix: Router emits phase_resume metadata and persistent chat creates a generic implementation preview/approval from the existing report evidence.

fixed.root_cause: Existing readonly audit reports had no explicit idempotent reuse path.
fixed.fix: WorkspaceReadonlyAuditReportService uses a configurable existing-report strategy and currently returns existing_report_reused when the target report already exists.

fixed.root_cause: ChatService project-generation previews returned a generic preview without creating TaskDraft, TaskPreview or ApprovalRequest.
fixed.fix: Project create/generation operations now create OperationContract, TaskContractDraft, TaskPreview and ApprovalRequest when policy is ask.

results: 24 passed in combined governed write + hotfix suite

smoke.cleanup: Smoke approval and grant were closed after validation to avoid artificial pending runtime state.

risks_remaining: Final execution after approval still depends on the existing runtime/queue services.
Phase resume creates a generic implementation preview; detailed implementation quality depends on planner/executor services.
No real LogForge build was executed in this hotfix.
The live backend on port 9088 may require an elevated restart if an old Python PID is still holding the port.
